variable.description: NEVER COMMIT A VALUE HERE. service_role bypasses ALL RLS, including the 0143 lockdown, over the public internet. Set it locally in a Postman Environment (not the collection), or export it as a Postman 'secret' variable type. The previous literal value was leaked in git history from commit 6520808 until 2026-08-04 and MUST be treated as compromised until JWT_SECRET is rotated — see docs/security/SECRET_ROTATION_RUNBOOK.md.
